summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of Smart Campus Student Portal. 31/31 pytest backend tests passed (auth, meta, subjects, papers CRUD, bookmarks, admin RBAC, admin paper upload+delete via object storage, timetable (personal + validation), exams (personal), tasks, marks, dashboard, AI important + status). Frontend: student/admin login, wrong-password error, dashboard, paper hub navigation (dept -> year/sem tabs -> subject cards -> exam-type/exam-year chips -> paper cards grouped by year, 168 papers), paper preview modal (PDF rendered via react-pdf) with Download/Print/Open/Bookmark/related papers, Ctrl+K command search, Saved page, Admin studio (upload form, manage papers/subjects/timetable/exams tabs, stats), Timetable with day tabs + 'My slot' button, Exams with 'My schedule' button, Planner (task kanban + focus timer), Progress (subject + semester trend charts, scores list), AI tutor (Gemini streaming response verified end-to-end in ~6s), theme toggle, mobile 390px bottom nav + More sheet. Non-admin blocked from /admin (redirected to /) and /api/admin/* returns 403.

minor.issue: Does not validate ISO date (calls date.fromisoformat but result is not raised as HTTPException via try/except like /exams/mine). An invalid date would surface as 500 instead of 400.
Accepts token via query string 'auth' which is OK for inline PDF viewing, but tokens may leak via referrer/log; consider short-lived signed URLs.

design_issues.screen: AI tutor subject select on desktop
issues: Harmless React warning: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' when subject list first loads

action_items: Fix React controlled/uncontrolled warning on AI tutor subject Select (initialize value to empty string instead of undefined)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (866 lines) exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, papers.py, admin.py, planner.py).
/api/papers/{pid}/file accepts auth token in query param ('auth'); OK for react-pdf but prefer signed short-lived URLs or cookie-only.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; relies on CORS_ORIGINS env being set correctly in production.
Login lockout tracked per (ip,email) is fine, but a shared NAT could lock legitimate users; consider per-email lockout with separate ip rate limit.

seed_data_creation: Pytest created 1 TEST_ subject, 1 uploaded paper (deleted inside test), 1 TEST_ user, personal timetable/exam/task/mark entries (all deleted in-test). Residual TEST_ subject + registered test_user_* email were cleaned via Mongo script after tests. DB is back to seeded state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 7080 seeded papers (PDFs generated on-the-fly via pdfgen). Admin upload uses external object storage (emergent integrations) and works end-to-end. AI chat uses GEMINI_API_KEY from backend/.env with model gemini-3-flash-preview and emergentintegrations.llm.chat; streaming SSE verified. Paper hub route is /papers (not /hub). Preview modal appears when clicking the 'Preview' button on a paper card (testid paper-card-preview-button-{id}).
rca of the issue: No critical issues detected. All reviewed features work as designed.
